title: rust-comp: Local diff viewer (Tauri v2 + React/TypeScript)
description:
## Background
GitHub UIと完全一致のdiff表示を実現するローカルdiffビューアー。

## Goal
- comp コマンドでTauriアプリ起動
- GitHub UIと同等のdiff表示
- GitHub/GitLab UIテーマ切り替え

## Tech Stack
- Backend: Rust + Tauri v2
- Frontend: React + TypeScript + Vite
- Binary name: comp

title: Tauri v2 + React/TypeScript project scaffolding
description: create-tauri-app with react-ts template, pnpm, Tauri v2. Binary name: comp (configured in Cargo.toml [[bin]])
notes: ✅ COMPLETED: Directory created, template scaffolded, pnpm install done.

title: Syntax highlighting (highlight.js integration)
description: Integrate highlight.js in DiffLineView/DiffFileView. Apply language-aware highlighting to diff content lines. Ensure added/removed bg colors override hljs theme.

title: Inline word-level diff highlighting
description: For changed line pairs (removed+added), compute word-level diff and highlight specific changed tokens within the line. Similar to GitHub's red/green inline highlights.

title: Tauri capabilities configuration
description: Configure src-tauri/capabilities/ JSON for file system access (reading diff files from temp dir). Required for cmd_get_initial_diff to read COMP_DIFF_PATH.

title: Build & install script (comp command in PATH)
description: Makefile or install.sh: cargo build --release, copy binary to ~/.local/bin/comp or /usr/local/bin/comp. Document in README.

title: Integration testing with real git diffs
description: Test: git diff | comp, comp HEAD~1, comp file.patch. Verify GitHub UI fidelity. Test all 4 themes. Test unified/split toggle.

title: README.md documentation
description: Installation, usage (git diff | comp, comp HEAD~1, comp file.patch), theme switching, build from source, architecture overview.

title: TypeScript type definitions (DiffFile, DiffHunk, DiffLine)
description: src/types/diff.ts: DiffLine, DiffHunk, DiffFile, FileStatus, ThemeName, ViewMode, AppState

title: Rust diff parser (src-tauri/src/diff.rs)
description: parse_diff(): unified diff → Vec<DiffFile>. run_git_diff(): shell out to git. detect_language(). Unit tests.
notes: ✅ COMPLETED: Written. Cargo check in progress.

title: Tauri commands (lib.rs)
description: cmd_parse_diff, cmd_git_diff, cmd_get_initial_diff, cmd_get_cwd registered with invoke_handler

title: CLI entry point (main.rs) - stdin/file/git diff detection
description: Detects: piped stdin, file path arg, git diff args, or default git diff in cwd. Passes diff via COMP_DIFF_PATH env var.
notes: ✅ COMPLETED: Written. Needs cargo check verification.

title: React frontend components (DiffViewer, FileTree, Toolbar)
description: DiffViewer/index, DiffFileView, DiffHunkView, DiffLineView (unified+split). FileTree sidebar. Toolbar with theme selector + view toggle.
notes: ✅ COMPLETED: All components written. TSC passes.

title: Theme CSS system (GitHub light/dark, GitLab light/dark)
description: CSS custom properties for 4 themes. GitHub Primer colors exact match. GitLab Pajamas colors. Applied via data-theme attribute on html element.
notes: ✅ COMPLETED: All 4 themes written + App.css component styles.

title: ThemeContext + useDiff hook
description: ThemeContext: theme + viewMode state, localStorage persistence. useDiff: loads initial diff via Tauri IPC, fallback to client parser.

title: Rust cargo check / build verification
description: Verify cargo check passes. Fix any compilation errors (main.rs isatty, lib exports, diff.rs). Run cargo test.
notes: 🔄 IN PROGRESS: cargo check running in nix-shell
